ENGINE_AUTHORITY.NEIGHBORHOOD: For each of 20 slots, replace its ticket with every ticket in C(49,6), excluding incumbent portfolio tickets; 20 * 13,983,816 candidates per complete neighborhood.
ENGINE_AUTHORITY.PRUNING: No candidate shortlist or heuristic pruning; complete exact enumeration of the authorized neighborhood.
ENGINE_AUTHORITY.ACCEPTANCE: Accept only a strictly positive maximum exact delta; stop after a complete neighborhood with maximum delta <= 0.
ENGINE_AUTHORITY.TIE_BREAK: Among equal maximal positive gains, choose the lowest SHA256 of the normalized resulting portfolio using portfolio_sha256; per-slot argmax uses the same rule.

START_HASH_CONVENTION: SHA256 of compact JSON for BEST_PORTFOLIO in sealed artifact order.
FINAL_HASH_CONVENTION: SHA256 of compact JSON for FINAL_TICKETS; preserved sealed order because no move was accepted.
